blocking_change_required: After before-byte capture, assert SHA(before[STARTUP])==STARTUP_SHA and SHA(before[UI])==UI_SHA. Otherwise a prefix-to-capture concurrent change can become the CAS expected bytes while after values still derive from the old snapshot.
rollback_guard_recommended: Call units(); owner() before each CAS rollback; unknown foreign/current bytes must not be overwritten.
if_already_submitted: Do not resend or blind rollback. Read saved before-byte hashes and actual new files/applied receipt to reconcile.
